title: Fifty Pence Worth of Trouble
question: Did George get anything for his fifty pence? What?

meanings.usage: 此处表示对小礼物的喜爱和重视，后面可直接接名词作宾语

meanings.meaning: 便士（英国货币单位，penny的复数形式）
meanings.usage: 是英国辅币单位，100便士等于1英镑
用于形容人在花钱上很节省，褒义词
指物体碰到硬面后弹回，也可指人蹦跳着走
英式英语用词，对应美式英语的sidewalk
此处指路边的排水设施，作动词时意为“排空，流干”
指衣服的袖子部分，常见搭配roll up sleeves意为“卷起袖子，准备大干”
指用作润滑的油脂，也可指烹饪产生的油脂
常用搭配reward sb with sth，意为“用某物奖励某人”
此处指硬币在存钱罐里碰撞发出声响
用于修饰名词，表示超出常规的部分
表示一笔钱时，常用small/large sum来描述金额大小

phrases.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，前面加金额，后面接名词，说明价值对应的物品

examples.en: I bought ten dollars' worth of snacks for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我买了价值十美元的零食用于野餐。

examples.en: He gave me two yuan worth of stamps.
examples.zh: 他给了我价值两元的邮票。

phrases.usage: 表示（钱、物品等）可以用很长时间，很经花；也可表示“大有帮助”

examples.en: A little kindness will go a long way when you meet people in trouble.
examples.zh: 当你遇到有困难的人时，一点善意会帮上大忙。

examples.en: If you are careful, this bottle of milk will go a long way.
examples.zh: 如果你省着点用，这瓶牛奶可以喝很久。

phrases.usage: 表示“把……兑换成/换成……”，用于物品或货币的交换

examples.en: You can exchange your leftover foreign currency for local money at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在机场把剩下的外币兑换成当地货币。

examples.en: He exchanged his old phone for a new one by paying extra money.
examples.zh: 他补了差价，把旧手机换成了新的。

phrases.usage: 表示“偶然到达，最终进入”，主语常是物，暗含“不经意间去到某个地方”的含义

examples.en: Many of the books I bought never found their way to the bookshelf; they just stayed on my desk.
examples.zh: 我买的很多书从来没被放到书架上，就一直摆在我的书桌上。

examples.en: The lost key finally found its way into my jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 那把丢失的钥匙最后居然在我夹克口袋里找到了。

phrases.usage: 字面意思是卷起袖子，常引申为“准备动手干活，准备大干一场”

examples.en: After finishing the plan, we rolled up our sleeves and started the project.
examples.zh: 完成计划后，我们撸起袖子开始做这个项目。

examples.en: Roll up your sleeves; we have a lot of dishes to wash today.
examples.zh: 准备干活吧，我们今天有好多盘子要洗。

phrases.usage: 插入语，意为“而且，更重要的是”，用于补充说明更严重或更重要的情况

examples.en: It's difficult to finish this task in one day, and what is more, we don't have enough tools.
examples.zh: 一天内完成这个任务很难，而且我们还没有足够的工具。

examples.en: The hotel is not comfortable, and what is more, it's far from the city center.
examples.zh: 这家酒店住起来不舒服，而且离市中心还很远。

sentences.en: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
sentences.zh: 孩子们总是喜欢收到小额的零用钱。

sentences.en: Mum or dad, of course, provides a regular supply of pocket money, but uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income.
sentences.zh: 当然，爸爸妈妈会定期地给零花钱，但叔叔阿姨们总是额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: With some children, small sums go a long way.
sentences.zh: 对有些孩子来说，小数目也能派上大用场。

sentences.en: If fifty pence pieces are not exchanged for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes.
sentences.zh: 如果五十便士没有换成糖果，它们就会在钱箱里叮当响上好几个月。

sentences.en: Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.
sentences.zh: 只有非常节俭的孩子才能把钱箱装满。

sentences.en: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.
sentences.zh: 对于他们中的大多数人来说，五十便士买一大块美味的巧克力是很划算的。

sentences.en: My nephew, George, has a money box but it is always empty.
sentences.zh: 我的侄子乔治有一个钱箱，但它总是空的。

sentences.en: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
sentences.zh: 我给他的五十便士硬币和英镑硬币很少有能存到那里的。

sentences.en: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.
sentences.zh: 昨天我给了他五十便士，并建议他存起来。

sentences.en: Instead, he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.
sentences.zh: 结果，他却给自己买来了五十便士的麻烦。

sentences.en: On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
sentences.zh: 在去糖果店的路上，他把五十便士掉了，它沿着人行道跳动，然后掉进了一个下水道。

sentences.en: rolled up his sleeves and pushed his right arm through the drain cover.
sentences.zh: 卷起袖子，把右臂伸进了下水道盖子。

sentences.en: He could not find his 50 pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
sentences.zh: 他到处都找不到他的五十便士硬币，更糟的是，他抽不出他的胳膊了。

sentences.en: A crowd of people gathered round him and a lady rubbed his arm with soap and butter, but George was firmly stuck.
sentences.zh: 一群人围在他周围，一位女士用肥皂和黄油擦他的胳膊，但乔治被牢牢地卡住了。

sentences.en: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighters freed George using a special type of grease.
sentences.zh: 消防队被叫来了，两名消防队员用一种特殊的润滑脂把乔治解救了出来。

sentences.en: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.
sentences.zh: 乔治并没有因为这次经历而太难过，因为糖果店的老板娘听说了他的麻烦，并奖励了他一大盒巧克力。

exercises.prompt: “额外的，附加的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: extra · /ˈekstrə/ · adjective · 额外的，附加的。用于修饰名词，表示超出常规的部分

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：感激，欣赏；喜欢
exercises.explain: appreciate · /əˈpriːʃieɪt/ · verb · 感激，欣赏；喜欢。此处表示对小礼物的喜爱和重视，后面可直接接名词作宾语

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：If you are careful, this bottle of milk will _____.
exercises.hint: 如果你省着点用，这瓶牛奶可以喝很久。
exercises.explain: go a long way：表示（钱、物品等）可以用很长时间，很经花；也可表示“大有帮助”（如果你省着点用，这瓶牛奶可以喝很久。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：With some _____ small sums go a long way.
exercises.hint: 对有些孩子来说，小数目也能派上大用场。
exercises.explain: With some children, small sums go a long way. — 对有些孩子来说，小数目也能派上大用场。

source.en: With some children, small sums go a long way.

exercises.prompt: “用于描述不受时间限制的客观真理、普遍存在的事实或者经常性的习惯动作” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他
options: 时间状语从句：There was a time when ...
一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律
exercises.explain: 一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律：主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他：当描述大众普遍认可的规律、常态情况时，不管上下文其他时态，都用一般现在时

source.title: 一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
With some children, small sums go a long way.
options: 除了她所有的其他优点，贝茜还是一位烹饪专家。
理查兹夫人刚走进饭厅，前门就传来了敲门声。
没有指纹痕迹，但警督发现了一个脏兮兮的红色包裹，里面装着珠宝，老太太说那不是她的。
对有些孩子来说，小数目也能派上大用场。

grammar.title: 一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律
grammar.definition: 用于描述不受时间限制的客观真理、普遍存在的事实或者经常性的习惯动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他
grammar.usage: 当描述大众普遍认可的规律、常态情况时，不管上下文其他时态，都用一般现在时

examples.en: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
examples.zh: 孩子们总是喜欢得到一些小额零花钱作为礼物。

examples.en: The earth moves around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕着太阳转。

grammar.title: because引导的原因状语从句
grammar.definition: 用来解释主句动作发生的原因，是最常用的原因状语从句引导词
grammar.structure: 主句 + because + 从句，或者Because + 从句, + 主句
grammar.usage: 可以用来回答why提出的问题，从句说明直接、明确的原因

examples.en: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.
examples.zh: 乔治对这次经历并没有太难过，因为糖果店的女老板听说了他遇到的麻烦，奖励了他一大盒巧克力。

examples.en: I stayed at home yesterday because it was raining heavily.
examples.zh: 我昨天待在家里，因为当时雨下得很大。

patterns.pattern: A is a small price to pay for B.

original.en: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.
original.zh: 对他们中的大多数人来说，花50便士买一大块好吃的巧克力是很值的。

examples.en: For many students, two hours' study every day is a small price to pay for a good score in the exam.
examples.zh: 对很多学生来说，每天学习两小时，用来换取考试的好成绩是很划算的。

examples.en: I think getting up early is a small price to pay for the beautiful sunrise on the mountain.
examples.zh: 我觉得为了看山上美丽的日出，早起一点是完全值得的。

original.en: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it. Instead, he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.
original.zh: 我昨天给了他50便士，劝他存起来。可他却用这50便士给自己买了麻烦。

examples.en: My mom told me to finish my homework first. Instead, I played computer games for three hours.
examples.zh: 我妈妈让我先写完作业。我反而玩了三个小时的电脑游戏。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to stop drinking alcohol. Instead, he drank even more than before.
examples.zh: 医生建议他戒酒。他反而喝得比以前更多了。

patterns.pattern: Sb did sth, and what is more, sb could not do sth.

original.en: He could not find his 50 pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
original.zh: 他到处都找不到那50便士，而且他的胳膊还拔不出来了。

examples.en: He missed the last bus home, and what is more, he forgot to take his house key with him.
examples.zh: 他错过了回家的末班车，而且他还忘带家门钥匙了。

examples.en: The team lost the important match, and what is more, their best player got injured during the game.
examples.zh: 球队输掉了这场重要的比赛，而且他们最好的球员还在比赛中受了伤。
